description: Implement markdown, sanitize, webhook, cli, and compress packages - text processing and utility packages
steps: Create src/stdlib_markdown.c with: markdown.render(string) that converts Markdown to HTML. Implement a subset: headings (#-######), paragraphs, bold (**), italic (*), inline code (`), code blocks (```), links [text](url), unordered lists (- item), ordered lists (1. item), blockquotes (>), horizontal rules (---). HTML-escape all text content for XSS safety.

Create src/stdlib_sanitize.c with: sanitize.html(string, config_map) that strips or allows HTML tags based on an allowlist config. Config map has 'tags' key with list of allowed tag names, 'attrs' key with map of tag->allowed_attrs_list. Strips all tags/attrs not in allowlist. sanitize.strip(string) that removes ALL HTML tags.

Create src/stdlib_webhook.c with: webhook.verify_github(payload, signature, secret) verifying X-Hub-Signature-256 (HMAC-SHA256), webhook.verify_stripe(payload, signature, secret) verifying Stripe webhook signature format (timestamp.payload HMAC), webhook.verify(payload, signature, secret, algorithm) generic verification. Reuse the HMAC-SHA256 from session or implement shared version.

Create src/stdlib_cli.c with: cli.args() returning list of command-line arguments, cli.read_line() reading a line from stdin, cli.print_color(text, color) printing with ANSI escape codes (red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, bold, reset), cli.prompt(message) printing message and reading response.

Create src/stdlib_compress.c with: compress.gzip(string) and compress.gunzip(string) using a minimal deflate/inflate implementation or linking system zlib if available. If zlib not available, implement a basic DEFLATE using fixed Huffman coding. compress.encode_response(body, accept_encoding) that returns {body: compressed, encoding: 'gzip'} based on Accept-Encoding header.
Add all 5 init function declarations to src/vek_stdlib.h
Add all 5 package registrations to src/vek_stdlib.c in stdlib_init()
Create integration test tests/programs/stdlib_markdown.ve + .expected testing basic markdown rendering
Create integration test tests/programs/stdlib_text.ve + .expected testing sanitize, webhook verify, cli.args
Run 'make clean && make' and 'make test' to verify everything passes
acceptance_criteria: make clean && make compiles without errors
webhook.verify_github with correct HMAC returns true
compress.gzip produces compressed output that compress.gunzip can decompress back
